title: Turbopack: chain the Pages Router development client module graph

target.summary: Chaining /_app into the page's client module graph in development causes next/dynamic imports in pages/_app to be chunked with the page's availability instead of /_app's availability. Consequently, SSR HTML for pages will preload chunk filenames that do not match emitted chunks, resulting in 404 request errors in the browser.
